attributes.action: STOP ST THOMAS OF CANTERBURY CATHOLIC PRIMARY SCHOOL FROM CLOSING
attributes.additional_details:
Its smaller environment is especially important for children with SEND, providing the individual attention, understanding and support they need to flourish. For many, this familiar setting is essential to their wellbeing and development.
Please look beyond finances and pupil numbers. Consider the children, families and community who will be affected.
Don’t let 179 years of history and community spirit disappear. Our children deserve to be heard, and this school deserves to stay open.
attributes.background: Save St Thomas of Canterbury Catholic Primary School, Fulham – Protect 179 Years of History, Community and Inclusion
